mission: Ben's child's-eye-view of the asteroid; unease without identification.
why_now: Ben's apprentice perception is now in a Sith setting.
opening_hook: Ben walking a side corridor with Jacen and Lumiya, registering something off.
conflict: Ben's apprentice-level Force-sensitivity registering the setting's Sith undertone vs. his trained deference to Jacen.
turning_point: Ben decides — silently — to say nothing.
closing_hook: Ben at the threshold of the inner chambers; Jacen and Lumiya already ahead.
setting: Vectivus asteroid side corridor leading to inner chambers.
sensory_details: Corridor's rough stone; faint subsonic pressure; Ben's apprentice robe.
emotional_trajectory: Alert attention → suppressed unease → silent compliance.

stakes.external: The corruption arc's path through Ben.

notes: Ben's positive-change arc resists but does not yet speak up.
